evidenceRefs.observation: Legible invoice from Borealis Store for a Borealis Slate 11 (BOR-SLATE11), serial BS11-24-0001, 480.00 USD, dated on the stated purchase date about 10 months before the claim.
Front photo: cracked screen glass with an impact point and crack lines across the display, consistent with the reported drop.
Back photo: serial label shows BS11-24-0001, matching the claim.

structuredOutput.reasoningSummary: The claimant dropped the tablet and the screen cracked; the front photo (EV-2) shows a cracked screen consistent with that account, and the invoice (EV-1) and serial label (EV-3) match the claim. Borealis Care covers one accidental-damage incident within the first 12 months from purchase (POL-6); the claim is made about 10 months after purchase and no earlier accidental-damage claim is known. No exclusion applies. Recommend approval and repair through an authorized service partner.
structuredOutput.claimantExplanation: Your Borealis Slate 11 is covered by Borealis Care. Your plan includes one repair of accidental damage, such as a cracked screen, within the first 12 months after purchase, and your tablet was purchased about 10 months ago. We are arranging the screen repair with an authorized service partner and will contact you with the details.
